attempts.summary: Implements FB_GateTelemetry with reset priority, strict timing-parameter validation, sequence-inequality freshness, saturating age accumulation, latched comm fault cleared only by fresh+Ack, and derived remote-write permit. Sequence history and age are preserved on illegal parameters.

Fixed power-up fault state by initializing internal fault to TRUE, so the first fresh frame without Ack leaves CommFault latched. All other logic (reset priority, illegal-parameter preservation, saturating age, fresh+Ack clear, derived permit) already conforms and is preserved.
